summary: Definium Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K on September 14, 2026, furnishing a press release under Item 7.01 and a conference presentation under Item 8.01. The disclosure reported positive topline data from the Phase 3 Panorama trial of DT120 ODT for generalized anxiety disorder. No transaction, activist, tender, going-private, restructuring, or meeting/management event was disclosed; the filing is an ordinary product-data current report and does not present a special situation. Key operational dates include a pre-NDA meeting in 4Q 2026 and an anticipated NDA filing in 1H 2027. Investors may monitor these regulatory catalysts, but no deal terms or arbs are present.
